This is the street race known as "Badlands B" which ends at a clearing southeast of Montgomery. You will use a ZR-350 in the race, which can be a pain because the ZR-350 does not have the best handling.

The Key to winning this race is to gently slow down when making turns, because accelerating while turning or smashing the brakes while turning will more than likely cause the car to go into a tail spin.

Sometimes tractors or mowers will spawn on the dirt tracks. Ramming into these will probably flip the car over, so just '''be careful!'''

This race is identical to the race in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi Mu]], but driven in the opposite direction.

In the cutscene you'll see Catalina's new lover: Claude, the main character of [[Grand Theft Auto III]].

== Rewards ==
* A garage in Doherty, San Fierro.
